'''Kuudra's Hollow''' is a [[Location]] accessed from the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. It serves as the home of {{MobSprite|Kuudra}} and its boss fight.

== Purpose ==
{{Main|Kuudra}}
{{zone|Kuudra's Hollow}} is where {{MobSprite|Kuudra}} spawns, and the fight takes place. It is a massive space, with a bridge leading to a large platform, surrounded by {{Item|Lava}}.

At the start of the fight, the bridge will collapse, leaving players only to the center platform. In the [[Kuudra#Phase 4: Stomach|Fourth Phase]] in Burning Tier and higher, players will be able to enter Kuudra's stomach, leading to a separate area. In the [[Kuudra#Phase 5: Lair|Infernal Tier]] of the fight, the center of the arena will collapse, revealing a lower section of the arena.

At the end of the fight, [[Kuudra#Loot|Loot Chests]] will spawn, one free, and one paid for by [[Kuudra Keys]], if Kuudra was successfully defeated. Additionally, if the player has donated {{Coins|1,000,000}} to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Believer}} in the {{Zone|Plhlegblast Pool}} within the last {{Green|30 minutes}}, the {{NPCSprite|Weird Sailor}} will appear for them on the edge of the arena. He hints at a list of conditions needed to fish up the {{Item|Wet Napkin}}.
